name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 1 Basic — Scent of the Lupine's Passing

system.description: By crafting a poultice of milkweed, wolfsbane, and other herbs, you can detect werewolves by scent within five feet by winning a Mental Challenge, for as long as the poultice remains effective.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
